metadata.title: Sunitinib 37.5 mg Therapy – 28 day
metadata.indication: Unresectable or metastatic, well-differentiated pancreatic neuroendocrine tumour with disease progression in an adult.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

contexts.duration_text: Continuous daily treatment until progression or unacceptable toxicity

source_conflicts.resolution: NCCP suggests considering 75% original dose in Child-Pugh C; EMA cannot recommend use because it was not studied. Consultant/pharmacy reconciliation required; no automatic percentage or numeric dose.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Every dose change requires Consultant Medical Oncologist review. Preserve current prescribed dose and all prior reductions; no automatic restart or escalation. Resolve the Child-Pugh C NCCP/EMA source conflict before prescribing.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding includes NCCP 00327 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Unresectable or metastatic, well-differentiated pancreatic neuroendocrine tumour with disease progression in an adult.

treatment.schedule_summary: Sunitinib 37.5 mg orally once daily continuously. The 28-day cycle is a review interval, with no scheduled off-week.
treatment.duration_text: Continue until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity
treatment.administration: Continuous once-daily oral dosing at the same time; consistently with or without food; swallow capsules whole with water. No routine treatment-free week.
treatment.missed_dose: Do not take an additional dose. Take the usual prescribed dose the following day.

components.note: Continuous daily treatment without a scheduled off-week. Take at the same time each day, consistently with or without food; swallow whole with water. Missed dose: no additional dose; take the usual prescribed dose the following day.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

other_toxicity_grade.label: Current grade of other treatment-related toxicity (including diarrhoea/mucositis)
other_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: CTCAE v5 UI aid only: NCCP 00327 table 3 gives grade-based actions without naming a CTCAE edition. Grade the named adverse event using its specific criteria; exclude HFS/cardiac and serious-event pathways which have separate actions.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only and intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; local or non-invasive intervention may be indicated; may limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

hand_foot_syndrome_grade.label: Current hand-foot syndrome grade
hand_foot_syndrome_grade.assessment_guidance: CTCAE v5 hand-foot syndrome aid (grades 0–3); NCCP 00327 table 3 does not name a CTCAE edition. Enter recurrence and retain the highest episode grade after recovery. First grade 2 still requires interruption.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Minimal skin changes or dermatitis without pain.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Skin changes with pain limiting instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe skin changes with pain limiting self-care activities of daily living.

hand_foot_occurrence.label: Occurrence count at the highest hand-foot episode grade
hand_foot_occurrence.assessment_guidance: Count occurrences at the grade driving the decision: reduce from the2nd grade 2 episode or1st grade 3 episode. Do not count low-grade episodes as recurrent grade 2.

qt_risk_present.label: Known QT-prolongation risk, relevant cardiac disease, bradycardia or electrolyte disturbance

indication_eligible.label: Adult with progressive, unresectable/metastatic well-differentiated pancreatic NET
indication_eligible.assessment_guidance: NCCP 00327a is a pancreatic NET indication, not all NET or NEC. Check pathology, disease progression and adult status.

severe_uncontrolled_hypertension.label: Severe hypertension uncontrolled despite medical management
severe_uncontrolled_hypertension.assessment_guidance: During treatment: temporarily suspend until appropriately controlled. NCCP does not specify a numerical BP threshold for this decision.

pretreatment_or_cycle_tests_missing.label: Required baseline or pre-cycle tests unavailable / not reviewed
pretreatment_or_cycle_tests_missing.assessment_guidance: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, TFT and BP; FBC/renal/liver before each 28-day cycle; TFT every 12 weeks; BP each attendance. Cardiac tests as clinically indicated.

options.label: New or worsening thyroid dysfunction on treatment

proteinuria_status.label: Urinalysis / proteinuria status
proteinuria_status.assessment_guidance: EMA recommends baseline urinalysis and monitoring. Do not substitute an invented protein/creatinine or24hour threshold.

current_dose_mg.label: Current prescribed daily dose (mg)
current_dose_mg.assessment_guidance: Never reset a previously reduced dose to 37.5 mg merely because current counts/toxicity have recovered.

episode_dose_change_completed.label: Dose change for this toxicity episode already implemented
episode_dose_change_completed.assessment_guidance: Record the current episode only. Avoid repeatedly applying the same dose reduction at every review.

other_toxicity_highest_grade.label: Highest grade in the current other-toxicity episode (retain during recovery)
other_toxicity_highest_grade.assessment_guidance: CTCAE v5 UI aid only: NCCP 00327 table 3 gives grade-based actions without naming a CTCAE edition. Grade the named adverse event using its specific criteria; exclude HFS/cardiac and serious-event pathways which have separate actions.

hand_foot_highest_grade.label: Highest hand-foot syndrome grade in this episode (retain during recovery)
hand_foot_highest_grade.assessment_guidance: CTCAE v5 hand-foot syndrome aid (grades 0–3); NCCP 00327 table 3 does not name a CTCAE edition. Enter recurrence and retain the highest episode grade after recovery. First grade 2 still requires interruption.

major_surgery_or_unhealed_wound.label: Major surgery planned / recent with wound healing not established
major_surgery_or_unhealed_wound.assessment_guidance: Temporarily interrupt for major surgery. NCCP/EMA specify no universal interval; restart only after clinical recovery assessment.

active_significant_bleeding.label: Active significant bleeding / possible GI perforation
active_significant_bleeding.assessment_guidance: Urgent clinical assessment; NCCP/EMA give no universal numerical restart threshold.

anticoagulant_use.label: Concomitant anticoagulant
anticoagulant_use.assessment_guidance: Review bleeding risk; periodic FBC, coagulation/PT-INR and examination as appropriate to the anticoagulant.

pancreatitis_symptoms.label: Signs or symptoms consistent with pancreatitis

liver_failure_signs.label: Signs or symptoms of hepatic failure

seizures_or_pres.label: Seizures / suspected posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome

unexplained_mental_status_change.label: Unexplained lethargy or altered mental status
unexplained_mental_status_change.assessment_guidance: Evaluate ammonia and metabolic causes; EMA hyperammonaemic encephalopathy warning.

tls_risk_present.label: Clinical tumour lysis risk present
tls_risk_present.assessment_guidance: Assess tumour burden, renal function, hydration and other risk factors; consider prophylactic hydration and close monitoring.

dental_onj_concern.label: ONJ symptoms / invasive dental procedure or IV bisphosphonate concern
dental_onj_concern.assessment_guidance: Dental review and preventive assessment; no universal interruption interval is specified.

aneurysm_or_dissection_risk.label: Aneurysm/dissection risk requiring review
aneurysm_or_dissection_risk.assessment_guidance: Review hypertension and personal aneurysm history before treatment.

lvef_percent.label: Current measured LVEF
lvef_percent.assessment_guidance: NCCP caution below 55%. Also enter clinical decline/symptom status; a percentage alone cannot establish change from baseline.

escalation_requested.label: Considering dose escalation for lack of response

treatment_weeks.label: Completed weeks of treatment for escalation review

haematological_toxicity_grade.label: Highest treatment-related haematological toxicity grade
haematological_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Used only for the source escalation eligibility review; CBC delay thresholds remain independently applicable.

action.message: Avoid strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, including grapefruit. If unavoidable, specialist adjustment may be needed to a minimum 25 mg daily for pNET with careful tolerability monitoring. No automatic dose change.
